newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meets Chernomyrdin, Turkmen president.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meets Chernomyrdin, Turkmen president.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin met Turkmenistan leader Saparmurat Niyazov on Tuesday to discuss the crisis in Afganistan and problems concerning oil deposits in the Caspian Sea, Interfax news agency said.
It said Yeltsin met Niyazov at the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow where he is preparing for heart surgery.
Yeltsin later held a separate meeting with Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyridin, who was also present at talks with Niyazov, Interfax added.
The presidential press office confimed that the meetings took place, but gave no further details.

Niyazov did not attend the summit of five leaders of the Commonwealth of Independent States in Kazakhstan's capital Almaty earlier this month, held after the Taleban movement seized the Afghan capital Kabul.
Chernomyrdin and the presidents of Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan decided against intervention in the Afghan conflict.
